title: helianthemum polifolium var. virescens
intro: Helianthemum polifolium var. virescens, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species in the family Cistaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, providing potential health benefits such as wound healing and protection against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe skin irritations, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents present in Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
